name: Interact client (Adaptive Interact)
description: Embeds the Adaptive Interact conversational AI search/chat widget on a Drupal site via a block, render element and admin-configured server URL.
project_description:
Adaptive Interact Client provides a simple way to connect your Drupal site with Adaptive Interact, our conversational AI and search platform.

 The module handles the integration layer, enabling your Drupal content to be indexed and queried by Interact, so you can deliver AI-powered search, FAQs, and digital assistants directly from your site.

 It is designed to be lightweight, easy to configure, and focused on giving Drupal site owners a seamless path to bring Interact’s conversational features into their projects.

 What Interact does 
 
 Drupal-first – Designed to integrate smoothly with your existing site. 
 Content-aware – Draws responses from your Drupal content, so information is accurate and relevant. 
 Better user experience – Visitors ask naturally and get straight to the answer. 
 Configurable – You control what content is included and how the assistant responds. 
 Inclusive – Multilingual support, accessibility features, and voice input options. 
 
 How it works 
 Visitors can engage with Interact in a few simple ways:

 
 AI Search Bar – A search box that opens into a conversational window. Users type (or speak) their question and get instant answers from your Drupal content. 
 Interact Links – Smart links placed in content that launch the assistant with context already included, so the conversation starts in the right place. 
 Pre-set prompts – Suggested questions or topics can be shown to help users get started quickly. 
 Freeform prompts – Users can type their own natural-language questions at any time. 
 
 Features: 
 
 Simple install and configuration in Drupal 
 Flexible UI widget that can match your site’s design 
 Launch conversations anywhere with Interact Links 
 Clear settings for admins and editors 
 Suitable for FAQs, knowledge bases, course finders, onboarding, and more 
 
 Why it matters 
 With Interact, your Drupal site can go beyond static navigation and offer a conversational experience. That means faster answers for users, smoother journeys across your content, and a more engaging way for people to connect with what matters.
